It's one of the best ways I've ever done a steak up.

Find yourself some 1" to 1 1/4" ribeyes, tbones or strip loins. Prep them as you normally would.

I use a pellet smoker but a charcoal grill with a water pan works well. Target a temp of 180-200 F. You're gonna need to keep it there for ~1 hour, so be prepared if you are using charcoal. Smoke the steaks until it reads the temp of your desired doneness. I like medium to medium rare.

While the steaks are smoking, get you gas grill fired up, or second charcoal grill. Basically you need two grills to do this right. Get it as hot as possible. When the steaks are done smoking, put them on the hot grill for ~30 seconds per side. Don't walk away or even turn your back during this part. All the fat in the steaks are ready to move and you will burn them if you're not careful.

Give it a try. You won't be disappointed.
